reviews.text: The friendly and caring staff, and the excellent Vet, gives you peace because you can feel they really want to give the best care to you and your dog. Mikayla is an amazing ver assistant!
I always had the best service in this clinic. Dr Cruz is the best, very caring and skilled. The staff is overall very nice and accommodating, they are very responsive to the emails too.
Excellent and caring doctor and the staff is very pleasant. Happy to have my pets be in their care
Super service!

We had to take our dog in because she wasn’t herself and was not eating. Turns out she had a tumor in her spleen. Long story short, from the moment we took her in she received quick and excellent attention. She had a successful emergency surgery and is recovering at home now. EVERYONE was extremely caring and compassionate with Bailey and us. The front desk staff was wonderful and the medical staff was on point, very knowledgeable and quick to take action. Thank you ALL for your quick attention to the very serious situation and for your kindness. Bailey is VERY grateful!!!

My dog has been going there for 4 years. Doctor Cruz always takes a quality Time to explain my DOG’S condition. For a specific condition that was not his specialty, he referred to a neurosurgeon. Very easy parking space available.
Redbird animal clinic has been our pups home for many many years, and we appreciate all the great work that they do and the love and compassion that they show our sweet babies.

My 3 year old Maltese had a right paw injury and was able to be seen within 45 minutes.  I thought his paw was broken after he tripped me, and I fell ON his paw and it was dangling.   He would NOT walk on it.🥲  Come to find out he’s just FULL of drama and looking for sympathy and bones! 🤣 Thank you for seeing my dog rapidly and giving him anti inflammatory meds- truly appreciated!
Excellent vet practice. Highly knowledgeable vets, patient and compassionate. People love the practice and the vets.

“Excellent experience every time we visit! The team is always very responsive and answers any questions first thing in the morning, which gives us great peace of mind. Dr. Cruz is wonderful—so kind, knowledgeable, and always takes the time to explain everything clearly. We truly feel our puppy is in the best hands. Highly recommend this clinic!” 🐶✨
Dr. Cruz and staff -amazing!!  Always welcoming, caring and friendly.  Best possible care for my furbabies-wouldn’t trust anyone else!  A+++++
Friendly staff. Effective communication. Demonstrated sincere care for my kitty.
Very professional
Goldendoodles

Our puppy had her spaying surgery yesterday, and the experience was once again outstanding, from pre-op communication to post-op instructions, and follow-up care. Dr. Cruz and his staff are knowledgeable, compassionate, and always take the time to explain everything clearly, which gives us complete confidence in the care our animals receive.

A wonderful, caring and expert Animal Clinic. Outstanding service, the best Vets you could ask for your K9 companion. Our family pets have been coming to Red Bird Animal Clinic for 30 years, and it simply keeps getting better. Finn loves it!

Honestly, I hate giving great reviews because I don’t want them to get overrun with customers. But their service was excellent and prices were very fair.

Update: 6/18/26 our second dog under their care. Had an emergency urinary blockage and required emergency surgery. Fortunately, I came to the office at around 2:30 on a Friday. They were going to refer me to a emergency surgery facility so I sincerely asked them if they could potentially fit me in for an emergency surgery into my absolute shock. They said they would do it. Two doctors and four staff members stayed past closing by about three hours to finish the surgery and release the dog back to my care. We didn’t leave till about 8:30. Just an amazing team that really does care for their patients and their families. Unfortunately, our Lulu passed due to complications a week later. But at least they gave her a fighting chance. I will be forever grateful.

Redbird Animal Clinic doctors and staff members have been most professional in caring for our three dogs over the past thirteen years. Whether it is making certain that we receive prescriptions in a timely manner to removing a bee stinger from the swollen lip of our beloved kooiker, they waste no time and do whatever it takes to aid. If you are looking for a highly skilled care group to guide you and treat your beloved babies, visit RedBird Animal Clinic. See for yourself.
Caring staff
We took our new puppy in for check up, very friendly staff. Dr. Cruz is a sweetheart,  explained, all to expect of our puppy, answered all of our questions. Excellent facility.
Excellent and fast professional service
Excellent veterinarians & wonderful care!!! I would never go anywhere else
Excellent. Personal attention.

Early Saturday morning Alphie got stung by a bee 🐝 or wasp and I call my vet they said you can come right way . They were as usual took care of Alphie and he was fine by 3 pm in the afternoon. Thank you 😊 …
Friendly, truly caring staff - doctors and support, not to mention my absolute confidence in their knowledge and ability in caring for my best friend.

Truly such a great clinic! My frenchie absolutely hates the vet and isn’t the most dog friendly and this clinic really does a great job running on time! The team here really cares and it shows as they really spend the time to explain what’s going on with your pet, so happy and grateful to have found this place🫶🏻
Dr. Cruz and his team are truly amazing! My husband and I are truly grateful to him for taking care of our Nahla Boo every time she comes in for an appt!!! Red Bird is awesome!
We had a favorable experience with Red Bird animal clinic. The staff is caring, the offices and areas are clean and the rates are reasonable. Highly recommended.

Dr. Phil Cruz, DVM is the best!

All staff and technicians are very courteous, knowledgeable and efficient.  Especially Dr. Cruz - he's the absolute best doctor. Really listens, takes the time to explain everything. Excellent bedside manner!  He's treated my pet babies for over 20 years!

Dr Cruz and his staff and just  wonderful ! Dr Cruz is very caring and  takes time to listen to any questions and concerns and wants to make sure our babies stay healty , he truly loves our animal's. Thank you to all ! 🐱 L. Little

Absolutely incredible service from the handling of our appointment, to attention at clinic, to delivery of paperwork. Everyone was amazing but Tasha definitely stands out since she was involved from start to finish. Beyond grateful!
The entire staff is very compassionate & patient. I have never felt rushed or waited more than 15 mins in the waiting room. I highly recommend this clinic. 🐾❤️ …

Every moment was special. First, when I called in as a new patient, Vanessa was so warm, caring and accommodating.  When I arrived for my appointment, I also received a very welcoming reception from Astrid at the front desk who made me feel completely at ease that my pup was going to be in excellent hands. The great care continued with Dee, the technician, who gave Mina lots of love. And finally, Dr. Phil. Wow, no words. He went into such detail about Mina’s issues, even drawing pictures to illustrate the problem with her knees. Even though it was a Saturday, just minutes before closing time, we were given all the time in the world. Dr. Phil is my new vet!
Trustworthy, experienced, thorough and caring veterinarian Dr Phil Cruz; competent and courteous staff; clean, organized pleasant environment.

Great experience at this vet!  After my long term vet retired, I feared I would never find another vet I liked, but I did!  Dr. Cruz is fantastic—so caring and knowledgeable!  The vet tech and front desk were also wonderful—courteous and helpful, answering all my questions and treating my pet with love and care.
Update 2 years later — still love this clinic. My experience there is always excellent and everyone from the front desk to the vet techs and, of course both doctors are really wonderful, knowledgeable and caring. Also, I love how clean and bright the office is. Highly recommend!!
Dr Cruz is second to none ! In addition the staff is pleasant to work with and willing to help in any way they can .
I take Ginger here for all her checkups and medical needs. The staff is friendly. The vets are smart. I can’t ask for more she it comes to the healthcare of my dog.
Fantastic crew they are amazing from the staff to all the doctors.   As always when  I call for an emergency appointment or drop off they make it happen.
I will not trust any other vet office with my animals. Dr. Cruz is the best vet in Miami, extremely knowledgeable and patient with the furbabies.

Attentive care. The staff listens to my concerns and advises accordingly: “ we cannot talk to them so we show by actions.”
And no one rolls their eyes when I speak to our cat as if she were a human child.
Thank you!
Red Bird Animal Clinic staff and doctors truly care about their furry patients. They are friendly, professional and considerate about your time. I would not take my pet anywhere else!

Many generations of our loved dogs and cats were and are Dr. Cruz’s patients. Since the times of the original small practice he was always assertive and very professional, but his most remarkable side is the compassion towards patients and families. He shared with us the times of joy of having a new puppy or kitten, but also was there to support us at difficult days of grief.
He is a five stars Doc!
Redbird animal clinic is amazing! Dr. Cruz is the best and the vet techs and counter staff are friendly and super helpful. They’re the best!
Everyone here is all about the best for your pet.  I merged here following Dr Lacret and have had years of great experiences with them.
Amazing experience, very helpful and welcoming staff plus the pricing was great!

I have been bringing our dogs and cats to Dr Cruz and Dr. Ferer For years now, and without fail, I have always felt the staff was not only professional, but also kind, accommodating, and well trained. A person always answer the phone rather than having to go through a phone tree when you might be stressed about your pet.
I referred many friends to them and they always hear positive feedback from them. I recommend them highly.
Dr cruz is very knowledgeable and nice . There staff is always very helpful

We brought our Goldendoodle puppy, Charlie, for his first wellness visit, and we couldn’t be happier with the care he received. The staff was so kind and patient, taking time to explain everything about his health, vaccines, and nutrition. The vet was incredibly gentle and thorough, making sure we understood his weight, feeding plan, and preventive care.

The facility was clean, well-organized, and easy to schedule with, which really put us at ease as new puppy parents. You can tell they truly care about their patients and take pride in what they do. We’re so grateful for their compassion and professionalism — highly recommend this clinic for anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring team for their pets!

Our dog Simba was in desperate need of help. He had a hot spot that was causing huge discomforts. When we called Red Bird Animal Clinic that morning, they were booked for the day. However, they were able to accommodate Simba into their busy schedule after we expressed his symptoms. We appreciate them listening to our cry for help and providing excellent customer service to Simba. Thank you!
Everyone at Red Bird Animal Clinic, from Dr. Cruz to the reception staff are very caring, knowledgeable, and professional.
Red Bird Animal Clinic provides exceptional attention and service. For 25 years Dr. Cruz has taken great care of our cats.

Red Bird Animal Clinic is wonderful. The Staff and Doctors are professional and welcoming. They care about your animal and you. They are also able to refer you to the best specialists and clinics if they are unable to meet all your pet’s needs. They will always be our primary veterinary clinic.
Thank you so much for the five stars! We absolutely love caring for Max and look forward to watching him grow and ensuring he is cared for at all of his future visits!

The team at Dr. Criuz’s office—veterinarians, technicians, and administrative staff—is phenomenal. They’re knowledgeable, caring, and accommodating.  I have nothing but high praise for the whole team. Thank you for all you do for our pet and those who visit your office.
I appreciate that the staff handle large dogs with confidence and care. Dr. Cruz’s diagnoses are always accurate, and the treatments provided have consistently been effective.
Best veterinary clinic in Miami!  Dr Cruz and his staff are friendly and knowledgeable and are great with my animals.
I'm very grateful to Dr. Cruz. My dog ​​is doing very well today after major surgery. I highly recommend this place.

Thank you Dr Cruz for your excellent communication and support for my senior dog. He treated us with the highest level of care and got us past a very difficult time.
After a trauma,  my senior dog was suddenly loosing her bladder when ever she fell asleep. He fixed her completely in 2 weeks.

Dr. Cruz and his Staff are excellent.
Keep up
The good work!
Thank you so much for your five-star review! We truly enjoy caring for Jackie-O and feel honored to support her health at 16+ years young. We look forward to seeing her (and you) at future visits!

Clean clinic, professional and friendly staff.
Knowledgeable vets
Thank you so much for your five-star review! We love seeing Lola and it’s always a joy to care for her. We look forward to many more happy visits with your wonderful gal!
Great help with 4 week old kittens left in a box next to our home. They are now on a diet of wet kitten food and being kept warm and dry. Getting stronger and happier every day.

SIMPLY THE BEST! OVER AND ABOVE OUR BEST Expectation  WE WERE REFERED BY OUR FRIEND  WHO SPOKE VERY HIGHLY OF YOU SERVICE.
REY VALDES
AMERICA NATIONAL FOUNDATION
The vets here are super competent
Great Vets & assistants... my dogs have been well taken care of here!

I’m very happy with this vet clinic as the communication is always on spot and they are very professional too. Prices are not bad compared to other clinic. They treated my boy with kindness and he is doing better. Thank you
Wonderful Vet. So glad I found them.
Dr. Lacret is a very experienced and patient vet. He has taken care of our 3 dogs.

We have been bringing our pets to Red Bird Animal Clinic and it has always been excellent
Thanks to Dr. Cruz and his amazing team

Great vet, great staff! Dr Lacret has been my veterinarian for years. His approach to veterinarian medicine is very sensible and logical and his bedside manner is superior. Extremely personable. Love him!! And my baby doggies are healthy and happy!

My dog is a rescue dog.  She was underweight and terrified of everything and everyone when I adopted her.   New surroundings still frighten her.   The staff and doctors at Red Bird Animal
Clinic are very patient and supportive of her.   The veterinary care is outstanding.
Dr. Lacret is very thorough and caring, very happy he takes care of my dog’s health!

I went less than a year ago to this vet after finding 2 kittens. The people were very kind but all they did was a fecal even after I had mentioned that kittens have been sneezing. They did not mention it could be any  respiratory infection (they ended up having a RI) since all my cats got pneumonia too and almost died from it. Took them to a diff vet to get treated. I gave 2 stars since people were nice but I did not like that they did not acknowledge the sneezing and it hurt all my cats... wont come back :(

Great clinic, I wish they take on human patients, the staff is friendly and knowledgably, the doctors are companionate and caring, the appointment time is within a week … this should be a model for our lousy human healthcare system in this country 😊 …
Excellent care

We have two golden doodles and one Siberian cat that we take here and we have nothing but good things to say! Front desk staff and assistants in the back are great, we love Emily! Spay surgery went great, healing has been a breeze and we’ll be back with our furry friends

We are extremely disappointed and upset by the lack of attention and care provided by Dr. Lacret. We took our dog, who had been under his care for at least 6 years, to him multiple times in the fall 2024. Multiple tests were run and we were assured that all was OK. Not to worry, we were told. Over the holidays, it became clear that our dog's condition was worsening. I called and left several messages for Dr. Lacret to contact us once he was back from holidays. He never did. In the meantime, we took our dog to another animal hospital and he was immediately diagnosed with an advanced cancer. He died this week.

Dr Lacret was dismissive of our dog's symptoms (a growing tumor, a limp, etc) and when I called and left a message for him to call when we were in crisis, he never called back. Prior to that, after repeated visits, he totally misdiagnosed our dog, assuring us it was only a regular growth and not to worry about it. It got worse and we took him to an animal hospital for a second opinion where he was diagnosed w/an advanced sarcoma cancer and died a few weeks later. We strongly feel he's totally incompetent. He killed our puppy and you should all be aware...

I had a terrible experience trying to see a vet here. I arrived an roamed the parking lot 15 minutes trying to get a space. I even called to tell them I could not find parking. When I went in 14 minutes late, they told me the vet cancelled my appointment because I was late. I will never go there again ..they did not care about my sick cat.

We had a wonderful experience at the vet! The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming, making us feel at ease right away. Our pet received top-notch care, and the vet took the time to thoroughly explain everything, answering all our questions. The environment was calm, which helped our pet feel comfortable. We’re so grateful for the exceptional service and highly recommend this vet to others!
The place to take your loved pets! The staff is very professional, polite, and caring. Dr. Phil is patient and understanding. He takes good care of all the pets ❤️

For over 10 years, my dog ​​Enol has been a patient of Dr. Lacret, and I've never had any complaints about him as a professional or as a person.
The staff is very professional, friendly, and helpful, and the clinic is always very clean.
Overall beyond expectations.Very positive
The staff and Dr.s here are all very professional, accommodating and kind. I have been bringing my baby here for years and will continue
Best clinic in the area
My experience has always been very good at the clinic, they care for my pets all my life, I am very grateful to them.
Dr Cruz and staff are the very best at what they do.  I recommend their clinic to all my family and friends

Everyone is always friendly and nice. I love talking to the other customers and meeting their pets. The veterinarians are efficient and personable as well. We always receive good care and have ever since we moved here 10 years ago.
The most caring and professional vet staff around.
The staff was extremely helpful
Our experience was amazing.  Dr. LeCret is amazing as always.  Our family completely trusts him with our pets.

Amazing care and service!
I took my cat here because he had stopped eating, and the staff was incredibly attentive and professional. They took great care of him and followed up on his recovery. Thanks to them, my cat is feeling much better. Highly recommend this clinic for pet care!
Dr Cruz is a Compassionate,  Caring  and a highly educated Vet. I've trusted my fur babies to him for years. Definitely 5 Stars!
The staff is friendly, treats my pets and me with respect. The prices are reasonable.
